Technical bug report or changelog format, describing a UI/behavioral issue with a "flag" parameter in a URL query string.

The pattern establishes a before/after comparison: first URL shows `?flag`, second URL shows `?a=1&b=2&flag`, implying a contrast or continuation about the same parameter's behavior.

The final token `&flag` ends an incomplete URL query string (`https://example.com?x=1&y=2&flag`), strongly expecting either `=value`, a closing punctuation, or continuation of the pattern mirroring the first example's `flag` parameter.
</br>
The repeated `flag` parameter appears in both URLs, suggesting the next token completes the second URL's query string, likely `=value` or a similar parameter name, referencing the "flag" mentioned earlier.</explanation>
